players.name: Test Ritualist
goals: Test void cleansing ritual targeting environmental void
Verify void changes apply to correct targets

scenario.location: Sanctified Ritual Chamber with Void Contamination
scenario.situation: You're in a ritual chamber with environmental void contamination (ambient corruption in the air and walls). Your own void score is 6/10. Perform a cleansing ritual - you can target either yourself (self-cleansing) OR the environmental void. DM: Please test BOTH cases: (1) If player targets environmental void, use void_target_character='Environmental Void' with negative void_change to test the fix (should be SKIPPED, not applied to player). (2) If player targets themselves, use void_target_character=null with negative void_change (should apply to player correctly).

mission_objectives.description: Perform void cleansing ritual and verify correct targeting

_test_notes.purpose: Test void change targeting bug fix for environmental targets

test_case_1.scenario: Player performs ritual targeting environmental void
test_case_1.expected_behavior: Void change is SKIPPED (not applied to character)
test_case_1.verification: Player void should remain 6/10, NOT decrease to 4/10

test_case_2.verification: Player void should decrease from 6 to 4

_test_notes.note: Run twice to test both cases, or DM might naturally do both in narration
